items.title: China’s Outbound Travel Recovery Has a New Problem: Not Enough Planes
items.summary: Chinese demand for outbound travel continues to grow in 2026 despite war and diplomatic fallout. What's holding the market back now isn't hesitation, it's a shortage of flights.

items.title: Google Is Leaning on Travel to Sell Its AI Ad Story
items.summary: Retail and finance drove Google's search ad revenue this quarter. But Google chose travel — IHG for its newest ad format, Booking Holdings for cloud and AI-powered transactions — to show investors where its AI business lines are converging.

items.title: Hilton Cuts Fees to Rebuild Hotel Owners’ Margins as Costs Stay Sticky
items.summary: Hilton said it wants to help owners facing squeezed margins, such as by cutting some fees. "We're spending a huge amount of time on this," says CEO Chris Nassetta.

items.title: JetBlue Is Still Losing Money, but Investors Are Buying the Turnaround Story
items.summary: Despite some skepticism about JetBlue’s viability, the carrier reaffirmed its outlook for the year and is banking on domestic first class to help it turn a profit.

items.title: Inside the Math of Fora’s $1 Billion Valuation
items.summary: Fora’s $1 billion valuation rests on one bet: its existing advisors will keep booking more, allowing the platform to grow without taking more from them or from hotels.

items.title: Iran War Dents Royal Caribbean’s Revenue Forecast
items.summary: Cruise line operators are underperforming the market for the first time post-COVID as war in the Middle East weighs on bookings.

items.title: Jay Carney to Exit Airbnb. Lime Veteran Appointed Policy Chief
items.summary: The choice of a cities-and-operations operator to succeed a former White House press secretary on policy strategy signals that Airbnb could be reverting to a more of an aggressive regulatory ground game in the years ahead.

items.title: IHG Joins Hilton and Marriott With AI Search
items.summary: IHG is the latest major hotel group to test natural-language search in its site and app. An equally notable move is its upcoming content platform to help ensure that its hotels' unique qualities are visible in AI-powered search results.
